end.summary:
Named cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toy/object examples.
Practised identifying flat and curved faces of solids.
Initially treated all boxes as cubes; later checked side lengths and identified a matchbox as a cuboid.
Initially thought a turned cone became another shape; later corrected this and kept it as a cone.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Aditya practised naming solids using dice, matchboxes, bottles, balls and rocket parts. They used length and point clues to distinguish a cube from a cuboid and a cone from a cylinder. They first mixed up boxes and cubes, and thought turning a cone changed its name; both mix-ups were corrected later in the lesson. At home, compare a dice, a box and a bottle, checking which faces are flat, curved, or both.
